name: mullins_2_resolution_guard

repair.key: order_refusal:kalshi:this market is expected to resolve in # hours, by its scheduled expiration (#-#-#T#:#:#Z); entries m

why: Corrected child of mullins-2. Its close-time filter admitted KXRAIN contracts expected to pay in 52 hours despite the day horizon's 48-hour limit. Require finite hours_to_resolve in [0, 48], with no close-time fallback, while preserving the parent's specialty and other decision logic. Born on rung 0 with no inherited record; qualification and nonrecurrence must be established independently.
